figurative_meaning_bn: অতি অল্পসময়; পলক ফেলতে যেটুকু সময় লাগে সেই সময়ের মধ্যে; মুহূর্তের মধ্যে
figurative_meaning_en: In a very short time; in the time it takes to blink; in a moment
similar_in_english: In the blink of an eye
example_sentences_in_english: The event happened in the blink of an eye.
He made the decision in an instant.
note: This idiom is derived from Sanskrit roots and is widely used in Bengali literature and speech to denote instantaneous action.
